description: Reproducible code, configurations, de-identified prediction views, and audit outputs for a 22-endpoint, five-model, five-seed study of reliability after random-resplit validation-only ADMET model selection on fixed TDC held-out test partitions. The release includes dimension-specific candidate-pool comparisons and zero-refit selected-model analyses of Morgan-support risk--coverage and validation-fitted calibration. Selected-model Morgan-support ordering was favorable versus random on 20 of 22 endpoints but generally weaker than ensemble uncertainty; selected-only isotonic mapping improved ECE on 11 of 13 endpoint means and Brier score on 8 of 13. These are post-hoc descriptive sensitivities. Morgan support/error rank association is a support-score informativeness measure, not an accuracy or reliability oracle. Source code is Apache-2.0; generated prediction views, metrics, tables, and original figures are CC BY 4.0; model checkpoints and raw TDC data are not released.
notes: Mixed licensing: see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.md. Raw TDC data, source structures and labels, and model checkpoints are excluded.
title: Trustworthy ADMET Benchmark: Reliability Regret after Single-Metric Random-Resplit Validation Selection
